name: Grif Wildheart
summary: Outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Grif Wildheart trains young hunters. He teaches tracking, marksmanship, and how to tame beasts, guiding hunters from Coldridge Valley toward life alongside an animal companion.

sections.title: A Life in the Wilds
sections.body: Grif Wildheart has spent his life in Dun Morogh’s frozen wilds. Ironforge dwarves often choose the forge or the mines, while local mountaineers say Grif spends too much time among four-legged beasts. None question his command of the wild. Years of tracking snowbound ridges with seasoned hunting companions have taught him the ways of the predators roaming the crags.

sections.title: The Way of the Beast
sections.body: Young dwarf hunters finish their first trials in Coldridge Valley, then travel to Kharanos for Grif’s guidance. He sharpens their aim and teaches them to survive in the wild, but his true craft is joining hunter and beast. He sends pupils into Dun Morogh’s freezing wastes with a taming rod, where they face Large Crag Boars, Snow Leopards, and Ice Claw Bears.

sections.title: Journey to the Hall of Arms
sections.body: After a hunter calms three kinds of wild beasts, Grif’s training in Kharanos is complete. A hunter must also learn to feed, discipline, and train a new companion, so Grif sends his graduates up the mountainside to Ironforge. Beneath the capital’s vaulted roofs, they report to master beast trainers and learn to care for a companion meant to stay with them for life.

faq.answer: Grif Wildheart trains hunters in Kharanos, Dun Morogh. He guides novice Alliance hunters who have finished their first trials in Coldridge Valley.

faq.q: Where can I find Grif Wildheart?
faq.answer: You can find Grif outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, along the snowy road from Coldridge Pass to Ironforge.

faq.q: What does Grif teach novice hunters?
faq.answer: Grif teaches young hunters to improve their aim, survive in the wild, and tame beasts. His lessons cover wild boars, leopards, and bears.

faq.q: What beasts does Grif send hunters to tame?
aliases: which animals to tame dun morogh
faq.answer: Grif sends hunters to tame a Large Crag Boar, a Snow Leopard, and an Ice Claw Bear in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Where does Grif send hunters after completing their taming trials?
faq.answer: After the taming trials, Grif sends hunters to Ironforge to learn from advanced beast trainers how to feed and command their pets.

faq.q: What do the Ironforge mountaineers think of Grif?
faq.answer: Local Ironforge Mountaineers say Grif spends too much time with animals, but they readily admit he knows the hunter’s craft better than almost anyone.

angles.text: As a hunter, you learn beast taming from Grif and gain the chance to bond with wild predators across Dun Morogh.
As a dwarf, you can follow Grif’s mountaineer tradition and live alongside wild mountain beasts.
As an Alliance scout or sharpshooter, you can learn from Grif in Kharanos and prepare for the wilderness around Ironforge.
